senses.exPt: Não se preocupe, querida, vai ficar tudo bem.

senses.def: a person you have a romantic relationship with
senses.ex: My parents were high school sweethearts.
senses.exPt: Meus pais eram namorados desde o colégio.

senses.def: to become bigger, especially a part of the body
senses.ex: My ankle started to swell after I fell.
senses.exPt: Meu tornozelo começou a inchar depois que eu caí.

senses.def: to increase in number or amount
senses.ex: The crowd swelled to over ten thousand people.
senses.exPt: A multidão aumentou para mais de dez mil pessoas.

senses.def: to move through water using your arms and legs
senses.ex: My son learned to swim when he was five.
senses.exPt: Meu filho aprendeu a nadar com cinco anos.

senses.def: a time when you go into the water to swim
senses.ex: Let's go for a swim in the sea.
senses.exPt: Vamos dar um mergulho no mar.

senses.def: a person who swims
senses.ex: My sister is a very good swimmer.
senses.exPt: Minha irmã é uma nadadora muito boa.

senses.def: the sport or activity of moving through water
senses.ex: Swimming is good exercise for everyone.
senses.exPt: A natação é um bom exercício para todo mundo.

senses.def: a piece of clothing worn for swimming, especially by women
senses.ex: Don't forget to bring your swimming costume to the beach.
senses.exPt: Não esqueça de levar seu maiô para a praia.

senses.def: a large area of water that people swim in
senses.ex: Our hotel has a big swimming pool.
senses.exPt: Nosso hotel tem uma piscina grande.

senses.def: a piece of clothing that women wear for swimming
senses.ex: Don't forget to bring your swimsuit to the pool.
senses.exPt: Não esqueça de levar seu maiô para a piscina.

senses.def: to change from one thing to another
senses.ex: I switched to a different phone company last month.
senses.exPt: Eu troquei de operadora de celular no mês passado.

senses.def: a small control that turns electricity on or off
senses.ex: The light switch is next to the door.
senses.exPt: O interruptor fica ao lado da porta.

senses.def: bigger than usual because of an injury or illness
senses.ex: My ankle is still swollen after the fall.
senses.exPt: Meu tornozelo ainda está inchado depois da queda.

senses.def: a weapon with a long metal blade
senses.ex: The knight slowly pulled out his sword.
senses.exPt: O cavaleiro sacou a espada devagar.

senses.def: a sign or picture that represents an idea
senses.ex: The white dove is a symbol of peace.
senses.exPt: A pomba branca é um símbolo da paz.

senses.def: a feeling of being sorry for someone who is in a bad situation
senses.ex: She showed no sympathy when I told her about my problems.
senses.exPt: Ela não demonstrou nenhuma compaixão quando contei meus problemas.

senses.def: kind words you say when someone has died
senses.ex: We sent flowers and a card to express our sympathy.
senses.exPt: Mandamos flores e um cartão para dar nossos pêsames.

senses.def: a long piece of music for a large orchestra
senses.ex: The orchestra played a famous symphony last night.
senses.exPt: A orquestra tocou uma sinfonia famosa ontem à noite.

senses.def: a sign of an illness
senses.ex: Fever is a common symptom of the flu.
senses.exPt: Febre é um sintoma comum da gripe.

senses.def: a group of signs that show a particular illness or condition
senses.ex: Their youngest son was born with Down syndrome.
senses.exPt: O filho mais novo deles nasceu com síndrome de Down.

senses.def: a set of connected things or a way of doing things
senses.ex: The city has a very good public transport system.
senses.exPt: A cidade tem um ótimo sistema de transporte público.

senses.def: done carefully, following a fixed plan or order
senses.ex: We need a more systematic way of storing our files.
senses.exPt: Precisamos de uma forma mais sistemática de guardar nossos arquivos.
